So I need to pick up the AM Codex for my friends Birthday party at warhammer world and I am wondering are E-book versions any good? Or are they completely hopeless and I am better of buying the physical book.
So I need to pick up the new AM codex and I have a question

The E-book versions are great.

The caveat here is that I wouldn't pay for one.
Why wouldn't you pay for one? If you don't mind me asking

While they're easier to carry to / reference during a battle, they're still extremely expensive for ebooks. It doesn't help their case that the physical codexes/Army books (while still expensive) are rather nicely put together.
Ebooks are great if you've got an ipad to go with it that you're willing to cart around with your games, but it's often more fun to have teh book in your hands.

I for one love the feel of paper books. That and when I have the majority of spots in a reference document memorized, I find it faster to open the book and get to the spot than if I were to turn on my reader, grab the book I want, and then get to the bookmark. But that's just me being an old fuddy duddy.
